provenance.notes: Visually verified partial square. The table has unrelated transposition typesetting errors; it is used here only to corroborate unfilled substitution cells.

notes: These cells are unfilled both in the historical appendix and in Lasry et al. Table 2 / Lasry dissertation Table 6.2, not merely unknown to the 1918 analysts. Baseline fills remain separate hypotheses unless an independent constraint supports them.

An illustrative square in paper Figure 2 / dissertation Figure 6.2 places VF=6 and XA=5, opposite the baseline fill. It also prints N twice (AX and XG), contradicting the final key table. Treat the two digits as unresolved, rather than elevating the inconsistent illustrative figure to an established key.

first_part_candidate.model: Retain every source slot in order; insert exactly enough slots to attain the printed length 268; minimize changes to valid retained coordinates. The candidate is editorial, not established by this optimization.
notes: The editorial reconstruction retains the name-like strings GERAUS and MAHRER without identifying individuals. Their U and H are not supported under every fit of both alignment models.
FELDGR remains an unexpanded, uncertain abbreviation.
The field GRUKONACH?02 uses the same unassigned square cell VF as the directly read continuation; the possible digit is 5 or 6.
The first-part/second-part association is strongly supported by the part numbers, same senders/routes and matching reference, but is not an explicit cross-reference printed in the log.
